title: How AI does math with words
hook: How AI does math with words

beats.say: King, minus man, plus woman, equals queen. AI can literally do that math.
Models turn words into lists of numbers called embeddings. Think of them as points in space.
Similar meanings land close together, and the same relationship points the same way.
That's how AI search works. Search cheap flights, and it finds budget airfare, with zero matching words.
Every chatbot that searches your docs runs on this.
Words become coordinates. Meaning becomes distance.

caption: Embeddings turn words and sentences into lists of numbers, points in space where similar meanings sit close together. The classic word2vec example: king - man + woman lands near queen. It's why semantic search finds "budget airfare" when you type "cheap flights", and it powers chatbots that search your documents (RAG).
sources: Mikolov et al., word2vec (2013): king - man + woman ≈ queen
